The smooth noodles and delectable soup make a great impression indeed, but the most indelible aspects are the dedication and heart put into this dish…

heat-quelling-soup.name: Heat-Quelling Soup
heat-quelling-soup.effect: Increases all party members' Healing Bonus by 25% for 300s.
heat-quelling-soup.description: Baizhu's specialty. "This isn't actually medicine, merely something that can alleviate dryness." As Baizhu's concerned voice echoes in your ears, a bowl of lustrous fruit soup greets your gaze. "This dish didn't use to have sugar, but he was worried that you wouldn't be used to the bitter taste, so he added some to it," added Changsheng.

ideal-circumstance.name: Ideal Circumstance
ideal-circumstance.effect: Restores 40% of Max HP and an additional 2,350 HP to the selected character.
ideal-circumstance.description: Alhaitham's specialty. A dish created through the fusion of vegetables and meat prepared in a patterned frying pan. Improvements were made to the recipe, making it taste quite different from the original dish. The words on the food mean "contemplation." In the words of the creator: "Ideally, everyone should be capable of contemplation, but practically, it doesn't seem very possible."

invigorating-pizza.name: Invigorating Pizza
invigorating-pizza.effect: Restores 34% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 980 HP every 5s for 30s.
invigorating-pizza.description: Jean's specialty. This pizza almost seems more art than food. Just one slice is enough to have you raring to go. Is this what keeps Jean working so hard?

lighter-than-air-pancake.name: Lighter-Than-Air Pancake
lighter-than-air-pancake.effect: Revives a character and restores 15% of Max HP, then restores an additional 550 HP.
lighter-than-air-pancake.description: Noelle's specialty. These thick pastries are the special afternoon snacks of the Knights of Favonius. They give people the sense that they have fallen upon a layer of fluffy clouds, and seeing Noelle's smile makes the feeling all the sweeter!

mysterious-bolognese.name: Mysterious Bolognese
mysterious-bolognese.effect: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 570 HP every 5s for 30s.
mysterious-bolognese.description: Lisa's specialty. With an inexplicable aurora, this bolognese is so exotic that you can never have enough. Did she actually enchant it with some kind of magic?

no-tomorrow.name: No Tomorrow
no-tomorrow.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 20% and CRIT DMG by 20% for 300s.
no-tomorrow.description: Qiqi's specialty. The neat rows of ingredients seem at once exotic and delicious, and Baizhu says that Qiqi has spent a long time creating this dish. Still, once one considers that Qiqi has no sense of taste, just putting chopsticks to the food is going to take some courage.

nutritious-meal-(v.593).name: Nutritious Meal (V.593)
nutritious-meal-(v.593).effect: Revives a character and restores 20% of Max HP, then restores an additional 1,500 HP.
nutritious-meal-(v.593).description: Sucrose's specialty. It looks like some strange alchemical product at first, but Sucrose insists that it is a healthy and nutritious meal, the result of many experiments and painstaking improvements. Its healthy green color comes from a mix of cream and natural vegetable juices... Wait, vegetable juices?

omurice-waltz.name: Omurice Waltz
omurice-waltz.effect: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 1500s.
omurice-waltz.description: Kuki Shinobu's specialty. The soft egg skin almost seems to dance upon a stage made from sauce, with fluffy rice wrapped under its swaying skirt. This would even be a match for the work of Uyuu Restaurant's head chef. Truly, Shinobu's chef license was not earned in vain.

outrider's-champion-steak!.name: Outrider's Champion Steak!
outrider's-champion-steak!.effect: Revives a character and restores 10% of Max HP, then restores an additional 150 HP.
outrider's-champion-steak!.description: Amber's specialty. One side is obviously uncooked. The other side gives off a subtle scent of something burnt. Close your eyes and have a big mouthful, just to keep Amber happy if nothing else.

prosperous-peace.name: Prosperous Peace
prosperous-peace.effect: Restores 40% of Max HP and an additional 2,350 HP to the selected character.
prosperous-peace.description: Ganyu's specialty. The image of a resting qilin is by itself enough to calm a person down. Ganyu has put her well-wishes for all that is lovely in this world into this dish — and she's saved some of her favorite Qingxin flowers for you, too.

puppy-paw-hash-brown.name: Puppy-Paw Hash Brown
puppy-paw-hash-brown.effect: Restores 40% of Max HP and an additional 2,350 HP to the selected character.
puppy-paw-hash-brown.description: Razor's specialty. Carefully shaped to resemble a wolf's paw. You can really feel the effort he has put into trying human cooking.

qiankun-mora-meat.name: Qiankun Mora Meat
qiankun-mora-meat.effect: Revives a character and restores 10% of Max HP, then restores an additional 150 HP.
qiankun-mora-meat.description: Ningguang's specialty. The pastry is perfectly soft and waxy, as is the consistency of the meat, and the honey-like meat juices ooze out as you squeeze it. Wherever did the high and mighty Tianquan Lady Ningguang learn to make this dish?

qingce-household-dish.name: Qingce Household Dish
qingce-household-dish.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 274 for 300s.
qingce-household-dish.description: Yaoyao's specialty. It looks rather mundane as it is not displayed with the same luxurious aesthetic as dishes prepared by a fancy restaurant. However, as soon as you take a bite, the flavor immediately offers you a fragrant and intimate experience, certain to leave an ever-lasting impression. After a single taste, what's on your tongue will be on your heart for good. As for the reason, maybe the secret ingredient to this recipe is simply "caring."

quiet-elegance.name: Quiet Elegance
quiet-elegance.effect: Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 35% for 300s.
quiet-elegance.description: Kamisato Ayato's specialty. The arrangement is exquisite and elegant, much like the manner in which Ayato handles all his affairs. Any more, and it would have been excessive. Any less, and it would have proved a sight squandered. As you sample the dish, you find that its flavor is identical to that of Uyuu Restaurant's — amazing. But as you reach your chopsticks for that crystalline camellia, Ayato stops you... "That was something I made during sword practice. It's just a decoration."

rockin'-riffin'-chicken!.name: Rockin' Riffin' Chicken!
rockin'-riffin'-chicken!.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 16% for 300s
rockin'-riffin'-chicken!.description: Xinyan's specialty. Its demonic appearance hides an absolutely demonic spiciness. Eat it, tear up, eat some more, and don't stop till you drop! Surely only a demon could have invented such a dish!

satiety-gel.name: Satiety Gel
satiety-gel.effect: Restores 16% of Max HP and an additional 1,350 HP to the selected character.
satiety-gel.description: Aloy's specialty. The cross-section looks perfect, its shape is regular, and it gives off a cool air. At first, Aloy seemed a bit apprehensive as to whether you'd enjoy this rather unique dessert, but she was relieved when you wolfed it all down in one go...

secret-sauce-bbq-ribs.name: Secret Sauce BBQ Ribs
secret-sauce-bbq-ribs.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP and an additional 1,750 HP to the selected character.
secret-sauce-bbq-ribs.description: Wriothesley's specialty. Soon after kicking out his subordinates with the excuse, "Feel free to leave, but I'm staying! Things are heating up in here, and it could blow!", a meatastic delicacy greets your eyes. A full-bodied sauce slathered over flaky skin brings an extraordinary double blast of deliciousness, though as you taste it, it does seem to be practically identically to a condiment that has become awfully popular recently...

shimi-chazuke.name: Shimi Chazuke
shimi-chazuke.effect: Increases all party members' Healing Bonus by 25% for 300s.
shimi-chazuke.description: Wanderer's specialty. The mildly bitter fragrance of tea and the refreshingly sweet aroma of rice are perfectly blended together, leaving you to wolf it down insatiably. How did he manage to cook something so extraordinary? Ah, your expression must have betrayed this thought to him, for his face suddenly turns grim: "Have you finished yet? Stop gawking and go wash the dishes now."

show-me-the-mora.name: Show Me the Mora
show-me-the-mora.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 274 for 300s.
show-me-the-mora.description: Dori's specialty. After paying a large sum of Mora, you finally got a chance to taste the dish cooked by Lord Sangemah Bay herself. Firm chicken is covered in the silky sauce with a smooth texture. With the mind-controlling charm of its great flavor, this dish is spurring an impulse in you to spend another fortune just to get another bite!

slow-cooked-bamboo-shoot-soup.name: Slow-Cooked Bamboo Shoot Soup
slow-cooked-bamboo-shoot-soup.effect: Restores 34% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 980 HP every 5s for 30s.
slow-cooked-bamboo-shoot-soup.description: Zhongli's specialty. The ham is a butt end selected according to Yuehai Pavilion's gourmet standards. The fresh meat is pork belly, freshly hunted in Springvale, while the bamboo shoots are the densest you'll find in Qingce Village. It is then heated, slowly, gently, and with the utmost care and technique... Such a "particular" taste may only be shared with those who know how to appreciate it.

spicy-stew.name: Spicy Stew
spicy-stew.effect: Decreases all party members' sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 1500s.
spicy-stew.description: Barbara's specialty. Carrots cut into cute little stars make this dish... Wait, AHH, where did this spiciness come from!?

stormcrest-pie.name: Stormcrest Pie
stormcrest-pie.effect: Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 40% and DEF by 282 for 300s.
stormcrest-pie.description: Eula's specialty. It's hard to say if the unorthodox, non-full-moon shape is meant to flout tradition or express her "tooth for a tooth" ethos. A rich, savory, and smoky flavor emanates from beneath the golden outer crust, unlikely to be reproducible by anybody else in Mondstadt. Best not to tell her all this, though, lest she add it to her list of personal vendettas.

summer-festival-fish.name: Summer Festival Fish
summer-festival-fish.effect: Restores 40% of Max HP and an additional 2,350 HP to the selected character.
summer-festival-fish.description: Yoimiya's specialty. Watching the fireworks, your hands full of the snacks Yoimiya's given you, her carefree, child-like laughter in your ear as the pyrotechnic burst overhead... Amid this unique symphony of sounds, the plump goldfish in your hand almost looks like it might start swimming at any moment...

surveyor's-breakfast-sandwich.name: Surveyor's Breakfast Sandwich
surveyor's-breakfast-sandwich.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 274 for 300s.
surveyor's-breakfast-sandwich.description: Mika's specialty. The luxurious spread before you is a veritable hillock of ingredients, and as you take a small bite, each clearly-demarcated layer of flavor and savory spice spreads throughout your mouth, as if you have climbed some mountain of gourmet. Are these the culinary skills he has honed while with the Knights?

survival-grilled-fish.name: Survival Grilled Fish
survival-grilled-fish.effect: Restores 16% of Max HP and an additional 1,350 HP to the selected character.
survival-grilled-fish.description: Keqing's specialty. This dish was not grilled. Instead, it was fried from within through the delicate application of Electro. A gentle bite reveals fragrant fish under the lightly-charred skin, its taste perfectly balanced. So, is this how she survives in the wild? You really can't judge a book by its cover.

swirling-steps.name: Swirling Steps
swirling-steps.effect: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 1500s.
swirling-steps.description: Nilou's specialty. The crystal-clear cup that reminds you of an ornate jewel case contains a soft, melt-in-your-mouth pudding. The reddish coloration, like a fleeing trance, reminds you ever so much of Nilou's radiant, dancing form. Ah, would that this dance might last forever.

teyvat-charred-egg.name: Teyvat Charred Egg
teyvat-charred-egg.effect: Revives a character and restores 10% of Max HP, then restores an additional 150 HP.
teyvat-charred-egg.description: Bennett's specialty. For some reason, every single fried egg is a little burnt around the edges. That said, the burnt crisp does lend a whole new flavor to the dish.

the-endeavor.name: The Endeavor
the-endeavor.effect: Revives a character and restores 15% of Max HP, then restores an additional 550 HP.
the-endeavor.description: Kaveh's specialty. The golden crust of the biscuit is arranged to resemble the Palace of Alcazarzaray, and the meal rises like a tower from a pure-white pond of yogurt sauce. Though the creator of the dish has placed a monumental amount of effort into its creation, he seems to have missed the fact that all the biscuits must be broken during the process of consumption.

the-only-truth.name: The Only Truth
the-only-truth.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 114 for 300s.
the-only-truth.description: Shikanoin Heizou's specialty. On the tender, moist scrambled eggs lies a juicy katsu fried to golden perfection, its aroma most enticing indeed... Having been tempted to gobble the dish down, you are somehow seized by the urge to let out all that is hidden in your heart — this is not some sort of secret weapon of Heizou... is it?

traditionally-made-charcoal-baked-ajilen.name: Traditionally-Made Charcoal-Baked Ajilenakh Cake
traditionally-made-charcoal-baked-ajilen.effect: Revives a character and restores 20% of Max HP, then restores an additional 1500 HP.
traditionally-made-charcoal-baked-ajilen.description: Faruzan's specialty. The dark and sweet cake, lying as it does atop a minty-green sauce bed, almost looks like some enigmatic mechanism. Your hesitation must have somehow reached Faruzan, for she then straightened up to assertively reassure you that this was a traditional dish in Sumeru and that its flavor is guaranteed. But you can't help wondering... Is it really a "traditional" dish that catered to the tastes of Sumeru people a hundred years ago?

utmost-care.name: Utmost Care
utmost-care.description: Candace's specialty. The aroma of this dish hits your nose long before it can be plated up. It would seem that Candace's adept guardianship also extends to sustaining appetites... But, uh, this really is an extraordinary amount of Aaru Mixed Rice. How are you supposed to deal with this mountain of "overflowing consideration"?

victorious-legend.name: Victorious Legend
victorious-legend.effect: Restores 40% of Max HP and an additional 2,350 HP to the selected character.
victorious-legend.description: Gorou's specialty. The side dishes have been piled high to form a sight as moving as Gorou's own motivations. As you finish the noodles and soup all in one go and pat your stomach in satisfaction, you look up and see Gorou... smiling radiantly as his tail wags from side to side (the latter probably unbeknownst to him!)

wanmin-restaurant's-boiled-fish.name: Wanmin Restaurant's Boiled Fish
wanmin-restaurant's-boiled-fish.effect: Restores 34% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 980 HP every 5s for 30s.
wanmin-restaurant's-boiled-fish.description: Xiangling's specialty. This is the signature dish of the Wanmin Restaurant, combining Xiangling's heartfelt passion for cuisine. Anyone who tastes it will gain a pure appreciation for gourmet food amid the hearty and addictive blend of flavors.

way-of-the-strong.name: Way of the Strong
way-of-the-strong.effect: Revives a character and restores 15% of Max HP, then restores an additional 550 HP.
way-of-the-strong.description: Arataki Itto's specialty. He insists that this is a "heretofore unmatched dish" hand-made by "Arataki 'Number One Gourmet' Itto." Whether standing, sitting, or lying down, this'll fill your tummy in one shot and send you well on your way to becoming the second-mightiest being in the world. What a swell guy.

woodland-dream.name: Woodland Dream
woodland-dream.effect: Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 35% for 300s.
woodland-dream.description: Albedo's specialty. The fruits and vegetables are laid out like grass, and they stand tall like trees. In this miniature world-in-a-plate, you circle the mottled city wall, follow brown alleys, and enter the light orange castle. A sweet, tender taste then bursts forth like a blooming flower. You open your eyes. There is a smile in the white-haired prince's eyes.

fruity-duet.name: Fruity Duet
fruity-duet.effect: Increases all part members' ATK by 194 for 300s.
fruity-duet.description: A dual-flavored fruity beverage. Add a thick layer of pulp at the bottom and then pour in a smoothie made out of juice and tea. Its layered flavors of fresh fruit are so tempting that no one is able to refuse the drink.

fruity-smoothie.name: Fruity Smoothie
fruity-smoothie.effect: Revives the character and restores 1,200 HP.
fruity-smoothie.description: A beverage with simple colors. The smoothie made out of fruit-flavored yogurt has been arranged to resemble the blue sky and white clouds. At the bottom is a thick layer of jelly and finely-cut fruit. The revitalizing flavor makes this beverage the best choice in the summer.

meat-lovers'-mushroom-pizza.name: Meat Lovers' Mushroom Pizza
meat-lovers'-mushroom-pizza.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 272 and CRIT Rate by 8% for 300s.
meat-lovers'-mushroom-pizza.description: A pizza freshly baked from the oven. The crust is dotted with large chunks of meat and fresh mushroom slices. The sweet, stretchy cheese further adds to the charm. You have no doubt that every slice will be snatched away the moment it is served. Speed, therefore, is a gourmet's best buddy when this pizza is on the table.

minty-fruit-tea.name: Minty Fruit Tea
minty-fruit-tea.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 200 for 300s.
minty-fruit-tea.description: A cooling and refreshing drink. The invigorating tea and the sweet-sour taste of fruit blend together and energize your taste buds, and before you know it, you've already drained your entire cup.

super-magnificent-pizza.name: Super Magnificent Pizza
super-magnificent-pizza.effect: Increases all party members' Physical DMG by 35% and CRIT Rate by 8% for 300s.
super-magnificent-pizza.description: An exceedingly sumptuous pizza. First lay out a base of ham, then add in meat that has been chopped up into little bits for a dish that packs an unrivaled sense of satisfaction. Once roasted, the char of meat and the creamy flavor of the cheese are truly a tantalizing combination.

lantern-rite-special-triple-layered-cons.name: Lantern Rite Special Triple-Layered Consommé
lantern-rite-special-triple-layered-cons.effect: Increases all party members' Shield strength by 30%.
lantern-rite-special-triple-layered-cons.description: Traditional cuisine made to celebrate Lantern Rite. The ham, fowl, and bamboo shoots have been sliced into threads of equal length, and they've been laid out neatly in the soup bowl after being steamed at high heat, before being covered in consommé. The layers are distinct, and the mouthfeel is salty yet fresh.

bulle-souffle.name: Bulle Souffle
bulle-souffle.effect: Restores 28% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 620 HP every 5s for 30s.
bulle-souffle.description: A very small cake nestled within a Bulle Fruit skin. Pour the beaten egg whites into a Bulle Fruit skin that has been scraped empty, and bake it until the souffle has evenly expanded. The word "Bulle" isn't a part of the name just because it's in the ingredient list, but because the finished product allows the tongue to delight in bubble-like spongy softness.

honey-char-siu.name: Honey Char Siu
honey-char-siu.effect: Restores 8~10% of Max HP to the selected character. Regenerates 210~300 HP every 5s for the next 30s.
honey-char-siu.description: A type of roasted meat from Liyue. Richly red in color, aromatic, and intensely flavorful. Why, one might even faint from gluttony if one stares at it for too long. Between mouthfuls of delicious meat and rich sauce, one bowl of rice might seem too measly a match for this taste experience!

duck-confit.name: Duck Confit
duck-confit.effect: Restores 8~10% of Max HP and an additional 800~1,200 HP to the selected character.
duck-confit.description: A pan-fried dish. With the magic of "confit," the plump and meaty duck leg is cooked until crispy on the outside and meltingly tender on the inside ~ one cannot help but exclaim that every second spent on this dish is worth it!

cup-o-grainfruit.name: Cup O' Grainfruit
cup-o-grainfruit.effect: Restores 8~10% of Max HP to the selected character. Regenerates 210~300 HP every 5s for the next 30s.
cup-o-grainfruit.description: A snack made from Grainfruit. The fresh, plump kernels explode on the tip of your tongue, like a lively party that leaves a lingering sweet aftertaste.

cream-of-mushroom-soup.name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
cream-of-mushroom-soup.effect: Revives the selected character. Restores 250~550 HP.
cream-of-mushroom-soup.description: A bisque that can be found everywhere. Its creamy texture feels like a silky garment, and you seem to be dancing on the stage in this beautiful attire... The curtain has fallen, but the memory lingers.

grainfruit-meat-soup.name: Grainfruit Meat Soup
grainfruit-meat-soup.effect: Restores 20-24% of Max HP to the selected character and an additional 900-1,500 HP.
grainfruit-meat-soup.description: A soup that consists of a mixture of meat and vegetables. Any single spoonful includes soft meat, crunchy veggies, and a titillating spiciness... This cornucopia of shifting flavors decrees that you entertain seconds!

lohikeitto.name: Lohikeitto
lohikeitto.effect: Restores 18~22% of Max HP to the selected character. Regenerates 300~470 HP every 5s for the next 30s.
lohikeitto.description: A classic soup from the frigid regions. The creamy chowder, smooth as flowing silk, envelops each ingredient in its smooth embrace. As you take your first sip, you feel a gentle, cozy warmth spread throughout you, as if a vivid, golden sunrise is taking place inside your stomach.

tripes-du-port.name: Tripes du Port
tripes-du-port.effect: Revives the selected character. Restores 900~1,500 HP.
tripes-du-port.description: An offal dish. The flaky yet soft cow's stomach has an almost fruity fragrance. Unlike other surprising delicacies that take the world by storm, the dish is overflowing with rich traditional savor, and once you have a single bite, you simply cannot stop!

drink-455.name: Drink 455
drink-455.effect: Revives the selected character. Restores 900~1,500 HP.
drink-455.description: A specially-blended drink that's all the rage right now. Refreshing beyond belief, this invigorating beverage washes over you like sweet rain after a long drought, instantly melting away all fatigue and restlessness. "It's as if everything's finally right with the world!" was one customer's glowing review after finishing their glass.

fontaine-aspic.name: Fontaine Aspic
fontaine-aspic.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 6~12% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
fontaine-aspic.description: A cold dish made from seafood. The fish roe in the aspic explodes on your tastebuds, igniting delightful surprises. It didn't take long before you clean your plate. Since there is no one around... it's okay to lick the plate, right?

sing-your-heart-out.name: Sing Your Heart Out
sing-your-heart-out.effect: A little surprise from the Flower-Feather Clan.
sing-your-heart-out.description: A cool-flavored throat lozenge. These exquisitely crafted candies seem to send a wave of coolness down your throat, relieving hoarseness like bubbling springwater spilling forth and cleansing parched earth. Your voice is left sounding as clear as a newly-fledged hatchling, eager to spread its wings and fly up into the sky.

tomates-narbonnaises.name: Tomates Narbonnaises
tomates-narbonnaises.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 160~228 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
tomates-narbonnaises.description: A dish of meat and vegetables. Juicy mouthwatering tomatoes filled with hearty meat, each one has an agile, charming aroma, which explodes into a splendid savor after biting into it. After eating a single one, all the dark clouds in your heart will have been banished by the rich deliciousness emanating from your tongue.

consomme.name: Consommé
consomme.effect:
Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 10–20% for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
consomme.description: A soup with a recipe involving many steps. Mash ingredients, then stew the mash in broth, and finally serve only the clear soup from the stew. Mysterious gossip on the streets in Fontaine claims that a writer suffering from writer's block had a sudden burst of inspiration after slurping this soup down... But how can one be sure that such stupendous effects are really not false advertising cooked up by some restaurant?

fricassee-de-poulet.name: Fricassee de Poulet
fricassee-de-poulet.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 160~228 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
fricassee-de-poulet.description: A well-known Fontainian meat dish. The romantic rendezvous of cream and chicken instantly catalyzes a deep, rich aroma that lifts the spirits. It is said to be a favorite amongst Fontainians... One could feast on this fare for a lifetime and not fatigue of its fantastic flavor.

meatnado.name: Meatnado
meatnado.effect: Restore 15~25 Stamina after any party member defeats an opponent. This effect can be triggered once every 3s. Lasts 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
meatnado.description: A rather popular meat dish. The rich meat fragrance sweeps through you, body and soul, satisfying what your imagination envisions for bountiful meat. No wonder, then, that this dish often finds itself a place at any joyous gathering.

fontainian-foie-gras.name: Fontainian Foie Gras
fontainian-foie-gras.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 165~235 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
fontainian-foie-gras.description: A traditional dish of Fontaine. The tender and buttery foie gras greets your tastebuds with silky dance moves before waltzing down your throat like smooth satin. Such a supreme delight makes all other dishes you will have in the future taste bland in comparison ~ that being said, you can hardly regret eating it, can you?

cassoulet.name: Cassoulet
cassoulet.effect: Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 20~30% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
cassoulet.description: A simple rustic stew. Time is the most wondrous of weapons for catalyzing the creation of deliciousness, and time allows the meat in this dish to soak up the ocean of stewed flavor it is bathing in, becoming soft and fragrant. Together with the rich aroma of the beans, it conjures a warm delight in one's mouth that stirs the spirit.

xocoatl.name: Xocoatl
xocoatl.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 165~235 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
xocoatl.description: A Natlan drink made from Cacahuatl. The rich, deep fragrance of the Cacahuatl is infused with a pure creaminess, tenderly caressing your tongue with the softness of smooth silk, leaving behind a touch of sweetness that is more than enough to melt your heart.

fatteh.name: Fatteh
fatteh.effect: Revives the selected character. Restores 250~550 HP.
fatteh.description: A dish from ancient Sumeru. With the Glabrous Beans coated in the silken smoothness of the yogurt sauce, the smooth texture greets your tongue like a blissful dream. And even after you have awoken, you might still taste the filling fragrance of baked flatbread between your teeth.

ile-flottante.name: Ile flottante
ile-flottante.effect: Restores 18~22% of Max HP to the selected character. Regenerates 300~470 HP every 5s for the next 30s.
ile-flottante.description: A dessert made of egg whites. Light egg-white dew that floats on the creamy sauce is like mysterious treasure chests awaiting travelers' exploration. "Enjoyment" would be an understatement, for the dessert brings you the joy of opening a luxurious chest!

berries-and-fried-meat.name: Berries and Fried Meat
berries-and-fried-meat.effect: Revives the selected character. Restores 250~550 HP.
berries-and-fried-meat.description: Fried meat accompanied by mashed potatoes. The marbled meat is savory and flavorful. When paired with the natural sweetness of the berries, it feels like your tongue is wandering through the wilderness ~ full of delight and healing for the soul.

lakkaberry-madame.name: Lakkaberry Madame
lakkaberry-madame.effect: Restores 22% of Max HP and an additional 1,200 HP to the selected character.
lakkaberry-madame.description: A chopped chicken dish. Said to have gained real popularity in Nod-Krai, despite being an imported recipe. It has a sweet-and-sour flavor that is indeed most delectable. A different flavor, certainly, though judging by the name... was the base dish the Sweet Madame, you wonder?

fine-tea-full-moon.name: Fine Tea, Full Moon
fine-tea-full-moon.effect: Restores 30~34% of Max HP and an additional 600~1,900 HP to the selected character.
fine-tea-full-moon.description: A tea pastry containing egg yolk. The loose and delicate texture of the grainy egg yolk mingles with a faint fragrance of tea. One small mouthful brings earthy happiness enough to make you swoon. You could pop several in your mouth at once, and woe betide any who should seek to steal a single crumb from the corner of your lips.

lasagna.name: Lasagna
lasagna.effect: Restores 30~34% of Max HP and an additional 600~1,900 HP to the selected character.
lasagna.description: A baked pasta dish. The Song of Pots and Fire eulogizes the meat sauce's ascension to the Pasta Throne. The moment it enters your mouth, it graces you with bliss so unparalleled that you almost want to make today Lasagna Day!

steak-tartare.name: Steak Tartare
steak-tartare.effect: Restores 30~34% of Max HP and an additional 600~1,900 HP to the selected character.
steak-tartare.description: A fresh dish of raw meat. Tender meat that is minced properly and coated with egg yolk that tastes exceptionally juicy and sweet. The aromatic juice of the meat fills your mouth with euphoria, giving people an exceptionally pure and primitive gourmet delight.

poisson-seafood-soup.name: Poisson Seafood Soup
poisson-seafood-soup.effect: Restores 26~30% of Max HP to the selected character. Regenerates 450~790 HP every 5s for the next 30s.
poisson-seafood-soup.description: A seafood soup. The buttery soup resembles gilded waves under the bright sun, as the rich seafood aromas melt in your mouth. The bounties of the ocean form a harmonious masterpiece. After emptying the bowl quickly, you can't help but dip the bread in what remains ~ it would be a great loss to miss even one drop of it!

todays-boon.name: Today's Boon
todays-boon.effect: Restores 26~30% of Max HP to the selected character. Regenerates 450~790 HP every 5s for the next 30s.
todays-boon.description: A vegetable salad. A vibrant array of vegetables is given sweetness by the presence of juicy berries and delicately garnished with petals, creating a bountiful feast that blossoms across the taste buds.

midsommar-torte.name: Midsommar Torte
midsommar-torte.effect: Revives the selected character. Restores 900~1,500 HP.
midsommar-torte.description: A small cake made from Midsommar Berries. One spoonful is all it takes to whisk you away to a lush berry forest. Amid the vibrant, lively sweetness, there is a hint of refreshing tartness imparted by the Smetana. This cake raises the festive mood to the peak!

lucky-snow-delight.name: Lucky Snow Delight
lucky-snow-delight.effect: Restores 30~35% of Max HP to the selected character. Regenerates 510~930 HP every 5s for the next 30s.
lucky-snow-delight.description: A Liyue confection made from rice. Pure and white as fresh snow, it melts the moment it touches your tongue, offering a clean, delicate sweetness that lingers like a gentle echo.

nod-krai-hot-dog.name: Nod-Krai Hot Dog
nod-krai-hot-dog.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 6~12% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
nod-krai-hot-dog.description: Classic convenience food. Freshly cooked sausage paired with freshly baked bread. With each bite, the irresistible aroma of fat fills the palate. It's gone in a few quick bites, leaving you craving another.

blubber-profiterole.name: Blubber Profiterole
blubber-profiterole.effect: Increases all party members' Physical DMG by 20~40% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
blubber-profiterole.description: A cream-filled dessert. After the first morsel crosses your lips, you simply cannot help but scarf the rest down! Even the remnants of the cream lingering on the corners of your mouth is enough to flood your heart with contented bliss. If only every meal could be followed by such sweet perfection... Ah! How wondrous would this adventurous life be!

magmic-ode.name: Magmic Ode
magmic-ode.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 10~20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
magmic-ode.description: An ancient Natlan dish. The meticulous roasting locks the juices tightly within the ingredients, while a subtle smokiness lingers like faint golden threads sewn on rare woven scrolls, elevating the flavor to new heights. A single bite will make anyone uncontrollably cheer in delight.

crispy-roast.name: Crispy Roast
crispy-roast.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 160~228 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
crispy-roast.description: Large chunks of roasted meat. The moment it comes out of the oven, the rich, meaty aroma fills your soul. No wonder so many people from Nod-Krai say this roasted meat is like the warm sun when the cold falls and the biting winds blow.

petit-gateau-debord-revised-version.name: Petit Gateau Debord: Revised Version
petit-gateau-debord-revised-version.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 224~320 and CRIT Rate by 6~10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
petit-gateau-debord-revised-version.description: A petite version of the famous Gateau Debord. The velvety sauce is like elusive silk, slipping between your fingers and alighting on your tongue, while the gentle melodies of afternoon tea circle in the air, enchanting your heart... Perhaps this little treat will appear before you again in your dreams tonight...

boudin-noir-aux-pommes.name: Boudin Noir aux Pommes
boudin-noir-aux-pommes.effect: Decreases all party members' sprinting Stamina consumption by 15~25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
boudin-noir-aux-pommes.description: A traditional Fontainian dish. A perfect combination, with the sweet fragrance of the apples neutralizing the fat of the blood sausage. An enticing, slightly burnt smell wafts upwards from the plate, and the eyes of those who see it light up as they shout with joy and anticipation.

bulle-sauce-duck-breast.name: Bulle Sauce Duck Breast
bulle-sauce-duck-breast.description: A meat dish with the fragrant fullness of fruit. The citrusy flavor of tangerine gives the succulent duck a unique, fresh sweetness. It's so irresistibly delicious that you can barely stop yourself from reaching for the next piece even before you've swallowed the last one. No matter how much Fontaine's food culture has evolved over the years, it's no surprise that this dish has always kept its place among the classics.

apple-roly-poly.name: Apple Roly Poly
apple-roly-poly.effect: After you activate a Petrified Tree, a Ley Line Outcrop, or open a Treasure Chest, restore 16%~20% HP and an extra 600~1,200 HP to all party members. This effect can occur once every 5s. Lasts 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
apple-roly-poly.description: A traditional apple dessert. The mere aroma of the apples gives a feeling akin to situating oneself before a warm hearth. Before you can even think to slowly appreciate it, your hands move as if compelled by some other person, knife and fork in tow, reaching out for the next piece.

bathhouse-manjuu.name: Bathhouse Manjuu
bathhouse-manjuu.description: A filled Inazuman dessert. The crispy, flaky outer casing protects a rich and delicate filling, its sweetness dissolving on your tongue like worries melting away in a hot spring. As you eat, your tiredness vanishes without a trace, leaving you relaxed and at ease.

fruity-trio.name: Fruity Trio
fruity-trio.effect: Decreases Stamina depleted by climbing and sprinting for all party members by 15~25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
fruity-trio.description: A dessert with a romantic flair. The crispy and flaky tart shell and refreshing fruit fillings melt in your mouth. The harmonious coalescence of brown and white colors on the meringue reminds one of a stretch of gilded cloud in the warm sunlight. A pleasant surprise to your tastebuds indeed.

crepes-suzette.name: Crepes Suzette
crepes-suzette.effect: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 15~25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
crepes-suzette.description: Crepes with fillings. The light cream and delectable jam are composed into a symphony of flavor, folded into a masterfully cooked soft crepe, as though robed in silken perfection, inviting your tongue to join an elegant, endless waltz of culinary delight.

rainbow-macarons.name: Rainbow Macarons
rainbow-macarons.effect: Decreases Stamina depleted by climbing and sprinting for all party members by 15~25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
rainbow-macarons.description: Small, multi-colored round pastries. The crisp shell wraps a thick, soft filling, and all is right with the world. Try one, and it shall be as if a little kitten's nose is nuzzling against your chest. Surely no one could help but fall for such an experience.

roulette-special.name: Roulette Special
roulette-special.effect: Decreases Stamina depleted by climbing and sprinting for all party members by 15~25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
roulette-special.description: Colorful drinks. The sweet and refreshing notes of flowers and fruit are perfectly balanced. Having one glass is never enough, and before one moves the pointer, an inner prayer rises quietly ~ please point to a full cup!

stuffed-tofu-with-minced-meat.name: Stuffed Tofu with Minced Meat
stuffed-tofu-with-minced-meat.description: A savory tofu dish stuffed with a succulent meat filling. Each block of tofu is hollowed out and packed with a perfectly seasoned minced meat, then seared until golden-brown before being braised in a rich, flavorful sauce. From humble, everyday ingredients emerges a taste of home, the most beloved and familiar comfort food found in every street and alleyway.

gilded-chest.name: Gilded Chest
gilded-chest.description: Nicole's specialty. "Surprised? I already knew how to make this a long time ago. Well, back then..." "Lately, I heard from Mr. Nine that it's become popular again in Liyue..." "A treasure chest design, and a culinary icon all in one? I'm a genius..." As a golden "treasure chest" is set before you, a flood of nonstop chatter instantly fills your mind... It could only be Nicole. Your head may be left buzzing from the barrage, but the delight on your taste buds is even more rewarding than opening a luxurious treasure chest.

spinning-special.name: Spinning Special
spinning-special.effect: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 1500s.
spinning-special.description: Prune's specialty. "This Spinning Special is a game only grown-ups in Nod-Krai get to play! Hehe, I'll show you how it works." With a smug little flourish, she sets a drink-filled spinning tray in front of you. The juices are bright and colorful, sweet and delicious, but the moment you see the tray itself, your mind jumps to the words "Roulette Special"... Wait. Did she get the name wrong?

lakkaberry-pie.name: Lakkaberry Pie
lakkaberry-pie.description: A sweet treat from the borderlands. The comforting aroma of freshly baked pastry blends perfectly with the sweet yet tart flavor of the succulent two-berry filling. Rich flavors dance vividly across your tongue ~ no wonder this delightfully punchy treat has become a beloved and comforting staple on the tables of Nod-Krai.

crispy-spring-rolls.name: Crispy Spring Rolls
crispy-spring-rolls.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 165~235 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
crispy-spring-rolls.description: A deep-fried Liyue snack. With a crisp crack, the juicy filling bursts forth as you bite. Beneath the golden, flaky shell are not only layers of flavor, but the vibrant, bustling spirit of Liyue itself.

conch-madeleine.name: Conch Madeleine
conch-madeleine.effect: Increases all party members' Healing Bonus by 15~20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
conch-madeleine.description: A lovely-looking dessert. There's a saying in Fontaine: "There are only two types of people: those who love Conch Madeleine and those who haven't tried it." Everyone falls in love with this cake the instant they taste it!

harbor-fish-burger.name: Harbor Fish Burger
harbor-fish-burger.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 20~25% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
harbor-fish-burger.description: A fish burger. Freshly baked bread is sliced open. Then, layers of crisp greens, seasoned fish fillet, and sliced onions are added to it. Finally, it is finished with a drizzle of sauce. The burger has a savory-tart flavor that truly whets the appetite.

la-lettre-a-focalors.name: La Lettre a Focalors
la-lettre-a-focalors.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 20~25% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
la-lettre-a-focalors.description: A small cake, shaped into a long rectangle. The endlessly indulgent aroma of coffee and almonds draws you in and pushes your thoughts forward, as though you absentmindedly stumbled into an extravagant opera without even realizing it. You find yourself drowning in the twists and turns of this luxurious performance, and only hope that the finale never comes.

berry-herbal-candy.name: Berry Herbal Candy
berry-herbal-candy.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 20~25% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
berry-herbal-candy.description: A Nod-Krai candy. The moment this translucent treat touches your tongue, waves of floral fragrance and sweet-tart berries fill your senses, fresh and delightfully sweet.

bbq-beef-heart-skewers.name: BBQ Beef Heart Skewers
bbq-beef-heart-skewers.description: Marinated beef heart is threaded onto skewers before being barbequed over charcoal, grilling forth an enticing aroma and captivating luster. Add on a bit of grilled grainfruit and potato, and you've assembled the eternal golden ensemble of Natlan's street food scene!

barbeque-ribs.name: Barbeque Ribs
barbeque-ribs.effect: Restores 20~24% of Max HP and an additional 900~1,500 HP to the selected character.
barbeque-ribs.description: A crispy meat dish. Lightly fry the surface of the ribs until they exude a faint aroma, then wrap the crispy exterior with sauce, and finally, grill them slowly on low heat. The meticulous temperature control ensures that the exterior is perfectly crisp, while the meat within is kept juicy and tender.

blazed-meat-stew.name: Blazed Meat Stew
blazed-meat-stew.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 10~20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
blazed-meat-stew.description: Raw meat is seasoned with an array of different spices, then slow-cooked until tender. The moment you open the lid, a hot and spicy aroma wafts out to greet you. When you're not sure what to eat when it's time to celebrate, you can't go wrong with this!

borderland-crispbread.name: Borderland Crispbread
borderland-crispbread.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 88~126 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
borderland-crispbread.description: The pattern on the crispbread is created by pressing Icy Pebbles into it, while it's said that the hole in its center is also made in imitation of such. It contains barely any moisture, making it well-suited to long storage.

braised-meatball.name: Braised Meatball
braised-meatball.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 160~228 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
braised-meatball.description: Fatty and lean chunks of meat are mixed with crunchy bamboo shoots before being kneaded into a ball, fried, and then boiled. The finished dish is very popular, finding a place at home meals or banquets alike.

cheesy-crab-hotpot.name: Cheesy Crab Hotpot
cheesy-crab-hotpot.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 20~30% and Energy Recharge by 14~20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
cheesy-crab-hotpot.description: The ingredients are pre-fried and layered in a casserole dish before being baked until the cheesy topping begins to bubble. Whether for a family dinner or a festive gathering, this luxurious classic is sure to elicit gasps of admiration from everyone present.

cheesy-mushroom-skewer.name: Cheesy Mushroom Skewer
cheesy-mushroom-skewer.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 6~12% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
cheesy-mushroom-skewer.description: A skewer covered in mouth-watering cheese. The caps of Red Berryshrooms are removed, filled with a generous sprinkling of cheese, and then grilled to perfection. The rich aroma carries a faint fruity tang best enjoyed while hot.

chenyu-brew.name: Chenyu Brew
chenyu-brew.effect: Restores 8~10% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 210~300 HP every 5s for 30s.
chenyu-brew.description: Sometimes, one might compare life to the sweet aftertaste savored upon sipping a cup of tea.

chocolate.name: Chocolate
chocolate.description: It is said that where the Cacahuatl was grown has a decisive influence on the flavor of the Chocolate, bestowing upon it a completely unique flavor — whether that be rough earthy undertones or sweet fruity notes... You never know the flavor you're gonna get with the next bite.

coffee-bavarois.name: Coffee Bavarois
coffee-bavarois.effect: Restores 26~30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 450~790 HP every 5s for 30s.
coffee-bavarois.description: Though it is one of Fontaine's trademark desserts, its recipe is very simple and straightforward. As long as the proportion of ingredients is right, hardly anyone could fail at making this dessert. It has an exquisite texture with a touch of refreshing cold taste, and can instantly lift your spirits.

deep-fried-doublecrisp.name: Deep-Fried Doublecrisp
deep-fried-doublecrisp.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 6~12% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
deep-fried-doublecrisp.description: Between the fierce heat, the boiling oil, and the sautéing process, this is a stern test of one's skills. Cook for a few seconds too few, and your ingredients might be left raw. Too many, and they will be overcooked and lacking in crispness. As such, this dish is often chosen by experienced Liyue chefs to display their mastery.

feast-os.name: Feast-O's
feast-os.effect: Increases all party members' Healing Bonus by 15~20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
feast-os.description: A golden brown fried snack. Mashed chicken is shaped into a hollow "O" shape by combining them with onion rings. Mashed fish and potatoes are similarly combined into a round form, making up the meat of the "feast." Put them both into a pot of hot oil and presto — your "Feast-O's" are born amidst the crackling oil.

fireside-merriment.name: Fireside Merriment
fireside-merriment.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 10~20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
fireside-merriment.description: A generous spread of hearty meat cuts combining Snezhnayan cured meats with Nod-Krai ham and sausage. Many older Nod-Krai locals like to savor it by the fire with a drink in hand.

fish-and-chips.name: Fish and Chips
fish-and-chips.description: Coat fish fillets with batter and deep-fry until golden and crispy, then add a few chips on the side. This combination is so miraculous that whatever sauce you choose, it will always bring a hearty smile to your face.

fontainian-onion-soup.name: Fontainian Onion Soup
fontainian-onion-soup.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 88~126 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
fontainian-onion-soup.description: Stir-fry the onion until it is slightly charred, and boil it in broth. Transfer the contents to a soup bowl, add a slice of bread, sprinkle some cheese, and bake it in the oven. Well-seasoned chefs never cry when chopping onions, and here's their secret trick: Let the apprentices do the job.

forest-of-color.name: Forest of Color
forest-of-color.effect: Revives a character and restores 250~550 HP.
forest-of-color.description: Blanch the Grainfruit, chop the other ingredients, drizzle over the sauce, then stir until evenly mixed. Extremely simple to make, but even more importantly, it's so healthy that no matter how much you eat, you won't feel stressed!

fried-shrimp-beanballs.name: Fried Shrimp Beanballs
fried-shrimp-beanballs.effect: Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 20~30% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
fried-shrimp-beanballs.description: First, deep fry the bean flour balls, then stuff them with fillings, fried shrimp, and sauce. Though they may be slightly complicated to prepare, the fact that they're so delicious makes it all worth it.

fruit-tandem-turnovers.name: Fruit Tandem Turnovers
fruit-tandem-turnovers.effect: Restores 30~34% of Max HP and an additional 600~1,900 HP to the selected character.
fruit-tandem-turnovers.description: After the fermented dough is rolled into long strips, sugar and berries are added, and the whole thing is rolled up to bake before being sprinkled with chopped berries. Usually paired with coffee, this confection takes center stage at breakfast and during afternoon tea.

fruits-aplenty.name: Fruits Aplenty
fruits-aplenty.effect: Restores 26~30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 450~790 HP every 5s for 30s.
fruits-aplenty.description: Its invigorating and healthy properties have made it a firm favorite among the fitness-obsessed tribespeople of the Collective of Plenty, who often recommend drinking two glasses a day.

garlic-baguette.name: Garlic Baguette
garlic-baguette.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 66~95 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
garlic-baguette.description: Taken freshly out of the oven, the bread has a crispy, crackling crust, and soft, fluffy crumb. The aroma of butter and garlic further adds to the baguette's tastiness! No wonder you often see Fontainians buying a baguette on their way home after work.

gentle-sea-breeze.name: Gentle Sea Breeze
gentle-sea-breeze.effect: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 15~25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
gentle-sea-breeze.description: Its vivid blue-to-white gradient is evocative of cresting waves caressed by the sea breeze. Having a sip of this while on a holiday is sure to fill your heart with ease.

glittering-gemstones.name: Glittering Gemstones
glittering-gemstones.effect: A little surprise from the Children of Echoes. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
glittering-gemstones.description: First, use dough to create a gemstone fitting, before adding jam of different colors and flavors to the setting. The result resembles nothing so much as an exquisite gemstone pendant, but be careful not to mix them up with the real thing!

golden-tempered-jade.name: Golden-Tempered Jade
golden-tempered-jade.effect: Restores 18~22% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 300~470 HP every 5s for 30s.
golden-tempered-jade.description: Prepared with simple spices, it strives to highlight the authentic flavor of fresh ingredients. The finished dish has smooth skin, tender meat, and a fresh taste, and is especially delightful when paired with a dipping sauce.

grainfruit-chips.name: Grainfruit Chips
grainfruit-chips.effect: Restores 18~22% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 300~470 HP every 5s for 30s.
grainfruit-chips.description: After being scooped out of the oil-filled pot, the deep-fried chips are drizzled with sauce, sprinkled with cheese, and finally topped with shredded meat — thus is a hearty Natlan breakfast born.

grainfruit-wrap.name: Grainfruit Wrap
grainfruit-wrap.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 88~126 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
grainfruit-wrap.description: There's a simple saying in Natlan that goes like this: "A leaf to wrap your Grainfruit with will always fall." It's used to express the idea of things being fated to happen.

grilled-fish-in-mint-sauce.name: Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
grilled-fish-in-mint-sauce.effect: Restores 8~10% of Max HP and an additional 800~1,200 HP to the selected character.
grilled-fish-in-mint-sauce.description: The fish is scored, stuffed with spices, then baked. Once cooked, a thick mint sauce is generously drizzled over the top. The refreshing aroma of the fish is enough to whet anyone's appetite.

guhua-fish-and-lamb-soup.name: Guhua Fish & Lamb Soup
guhua-fish-and-lamb-soup.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 88~126 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
guhua-fish-and-lamb-soup.description: Fresh fish and mutton are stewed together, with the tenderness of the fish and the juiciness of the lamb blending transforming the dish into a true delicacy.

haggis.name: Haggis
haggis.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 215~308 and healing effects by 6~10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
haggis.description: A dish with strong and distinctive flavors. Chop up the sheep offal, mix it with oatmeal, and stuff the mixture into a sheep stomach along with various seasonings and spices. When the dish is served, the stomach-bag is usually removed while the fillings are served with radish paste and mashed potatoes. This is a local specialty that Fontainians often cook as a treat for important guests.

harvests-boon.name: Harvest's Boon
harvests-boon.effect: A little surprise from the Collective of Plenty. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
harvests-boon.description: A rich and comforting meal held together by the humble Grainfruit. Minced meat is stir-fried and placed in a baking pan with larger chunks of meat and eggs. The whole thing is then covered with a layer of mashed Grainfruit and baked until a tantalizing golden brown. This hearty dish can often be found on the tables of the Collective of Plenty during harvest festivals.

hot-spring-oclock.name: Hot Spring O'Clock
hot-spring-oclock.effect: A little surprise from the People of the Springs. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
hot-spring-oclock.description: Grainfruit is scattered across the crust before a thick layer of cheese is poured on top, and the whole thing is delivered into the oven. The final touch is to then draw a little Koholasaurus picture on it. Eat it while it's hot — the warmth will remind you of a serene time spent enjoying a soothing soak in a hot spring.

jade-fruit-soup.name: Jade Fruit Soup
jade-fruit-soup.effect: Increases all party members' Healing Bonus by 15~20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
jade-fruit-soup.description: The water is brought to boil, various ingredients are added in, and then it is simmered for some time before rock sugar is added. The liquid mixture is then simmered until clear and thick. The lengthy simmering creates a soup with a gentle mouthfeel, causing the ingredients to melt with just a light sip. Suitable for all ages.

jadevein-tea-eggs.name: Jadevein Tea Eggs
jadevein-tea-eggs.effect: Revives a character and restores 50~150 HP.
jadevein-tea-eggs.description: The flavor of the tea seeps into the egg through cracks in its shell while it is boiling, and the cracks are as beautiful as the fractured patterns of jade.

lakkaberry-krumkakes.name: Lakkaberry Krumkakes
lakkaberry-krumkakes.effect: Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 20~30% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
lakkaberry-krumkakes.description: A classic dessert from Nod-Krai. The batter is put on a griddle and swiftly rolled up, while butter is added and fruits are sprinkled on top. Crispy, crunchy, and sweetly aromatic, it is very popular among children.

magma-eggs.name: Magma Eggs
magma-eggs.effect: Restores 0<!-- Not actual effect, but is required for the effect description to appear -->~10% of Max HP and an additional 0~1,200 HP to the selected character.
magma-eggs.description: A jet-black egg, formed by absorbing the essence of flame and rock. Despite its obsidian appearance, it tastes just like a regular boiled egg — unless, of course, one were to go out of their way to cook it in an irregular fashion...

millhavens-morning-plate.name: Millhaven's Morning Plate
millhavens-morning-plate.description: Slices of mincemeat patty are heated through and served alongside fried eggs, sausages, and potatoes. Nutritious and hearty, this meal provides all the energy needed to power through a busy morning.

mini-asha-pockets.name: Mini Asha Pockets
mini-asha-pockets.effect: A little surprise from the Easybreeze Holiday Resort. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
mini-asha-pockets.description: Wrap the meat filling in dough, shape the pastry, then deep-fry until golden. Don't forget to paint on tiny sunglasses with sauce for a playful touch. It's not hard to guess why this snack is so popular — Asha are super, super cute, after all.

mushroom-phantasm.name: Mushroom Phantasm
mushroom-phantasm.effect: Revives a character and restores 900~1,500 HP.
mushroom-phantasm.description: The cooked mixture is folded into rye dough, allowed to rise, and baked. It resembles a real mushroom so closely that, if not for the shallow cuts on its "cap," you'd almost mistake it for the real thing.

mystique-soup.name: Mystique Soup
mystique-soup.effect: A little surprise from the Masters of the Night-Wind. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
mystique-soup.description: Originally invented as a type of medicine by a certain shaman of the Masters of the Night-Wind, the recipe has been altered with the passage of time and is now a common drink at social gatherings.

nanas-cake.name: Nanas Cake
nanas-cake.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 160~228 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
nanas-cake.description: Mix the paste well, then place into a mold and heat until fully cooked. The edges are particularly susceptible to burning. If you're looking for a perfect golden color on your Nanas Cake, the most important thing is to control the heat.

pate-de-fruit.name: Pate de Fruit
pate-de-fruit.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 10~20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
pate-de-fruit.description: It was first created as a way to preserve fruits. With the passage of time, the candy has made its way into every Fontainian's childhood memories. It is sweet and chewy, and one can never have enough of them.

poissonchant-pie.name: Poissonchant Pie
poissonchant-pie.effect: Revives a character and restores 900~1,500 HP.
poissonchant-pie.description: Mix the fillings and put the dough right on it. The key is to arrange the fish heads properly before baking. This way, when the dish is ready, every fish will gaze upward as if chanting in unison.

puff-pops.name: Puff Pops
puff-pops.effect: A little surprise from the Scions of the Canopy. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
puff-pops.description: If you close your eyes, you won't be able to guess what flavor you'll get next, and eating them is sure to increase your heart rate — and that's what makes this popular amongst the Scions of the Canopy. By the way, the "pop" part of the name comes from the sound of Grainfruit kernels bursting open under high temperatures.

puffed-grainfruit-bars.name: Puffed Grainfruit Bars
puffed-grainfruit-bars.effect: Restores 20~24% of Max HP and an additional 900~1,500 HP to the selected character.
puffed-grainfruit-bars.description: A tasty, technicolor treat that is delightfully crisp and sweet. When displayed prominently on snack stands, it possesses an almost magical ability to make children's pocket money disappear.

qingxin-flower-cake.name: Qingxin Flower Cake
qingxin-flower-cake.description: Prepared with Qingxin petals still glistening with their morning dew, the filling is wrapped in many layers consisting of two different types of pastry — a flaky crust and a buttery dough. Baked to perfection, Qingxin Flower Cakes are best enjoyed fresh from the oven.

saurus-crackers.name: Saurus Crackers
saurus-crackers.effect: Restores 30~34% of Max HP and an additional 600~1,900 HP to the selected character.
saurus-crackers.description: Light, crispy, sweet, and fragrant, with adorable patterns on top to boot — how could the people of Natlan not be won over by such delectable snacks? Apparently, even the Saurians love 'em... But are crackers really the type of thing Saurians eat?

shrimp-bisque.name: Shrimp Bisque
shrimp-bisque.effect: Increases all party members' Healing Bonus by 15~20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
shrimp-bisque.description: After stir-frying the spices, add the ingredients and simmer with broth until cooked. Up close, you'll catch a savory aroma laced with fiery, fragrant heat. The vibrant color of the broth whets the appetite at a glance, and it tastes even better.

smoked-fish-steak.name: Smoked Fish Steak
smoked-fish-steak.effect: Restores 8~10% of Max HP and an additional 800~1,200 HP to the selected character.
smoked-fish-steak.description: The steak has been cured and placed on a wooden slat before smoking. Not only does the final product preserve the fish's physical integrity, but it also boasts a unique smoky flavor.

sour-sauce-ceviche.name: Sour Sauce Ceviche
sour-sauce-ceviche.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 66~95 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
sour-sauce-ceviche.description: The fish — which must be fresh — is first skinned and cut into thick chunks, then marinated in the sour sauce until the fish turns white, after which shredded vegetables are added for seasoning. A combination of sour and spicy flavors, it is one of Natlan's most classic flavors.

stuffed-n-mashed-potatoes.name: Stuffed N' Mashed Potatoes
stuffed-n-mashed-potatoes.effect: Restores 26~30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 450~790 HP every 5s for 30s.
stuffed-n-mashed-potatoes.description: Mash the potatoes into a fine creamy state, add various fillings in the middle, then finally, drizzle with sauce for a touch of brightness. The end result is not dissimilar from a finely-made cake, and is the favorite dish of many in Natlan.

surf-turf-and-perch.name: Surf, Turf, and Perch
surf-turf-and-perch.effect: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 15~25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
surf-turf-and-perch.description: Various ingredients from the sea, land, and air have been roasted and mixed together. There's something for everyone here, making it a must-have at any important banquet in Natlan.

tasses-ragout.name: Tasses Ragout
tasses-ragout.effect: Restores 20~24% of Max HP and an additional 900~1,500 HP to the selected character.
tasses-ragout.description: It is an improvised dish created by Fontainian farmers celebrating vegetable harvests. There are no strict rules for the amount of ingredients or the cooking method. Be it stir-fried or baked, this unpretentious dish never fails to delight with its rustic savor.

tatacos.name: Tatacos
tatacos.effect: Revives a character and restores 900~1,500 HP.
tatacos.description: Making Tatacos is a three-part process — you bake the tacos first, you add vegetables and grilled shrimp second, then finally, you drizzle sauce over the top. In Natlan, it's hard to say which is a more common sight — phlogiston or Tatacos.

tea-smoked-squab.name: Tea-Smoked Squab
tea-smoked-squab.effect: Restores 20~24% of Max HP and an additional 900~1,500 HP to the selected character.
tea-smoked-squab.description: Squab is marinated in tea and sauce overnight before being dried and deep-fried, suffusing the meat with the wonderful aroma of tea. This technique has been passed down for many years and is a banquet delicacy.

trout-amandine.name: Trout Amandine
trout-amandine.effect: Restores 8~10% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 210~300 HP every 5s for 30s.
trout-amandine.description: Fish fillets of a satisfying size, fried with butter before serving with a side of crispy fried almonds. According to the traditional recipe for this dish, a whole readied trout would be placed into the frying pan, but a new, fillet-featuring recipe for this dish has been gaining popularity recently as well.

veggie-pot-soup.name: Veggie Pot Soup
veggie-pot-soup.effect: Restores 30~34% of Max HP and an additional 600~1,900 HP to the selected character.
veggie-pot-soup.description: It's mild, flavorful, and great for your health.

vessie-chicken.name: Vessie Chicken
vessie-chicken.effect: Increases all party members' by 25~45% and CRIT Rate by 6~10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
vessie-chicken.description: "Vessie" means "bladder" in Fontaine. As the name suggests, the seasoned chicken meat is enclosed in a forest boar's bladder when being poached in a meat broth. The bladder will puff out during the process like a rotund Specter. People usually only eat the chicken meat inside.

volcano-cake.name: Volcano Cake
volcano-cake.effect: Revives a character and restores 900~1,500 HP.
volcano-cake.description: The ingredients were mixed together, stirred into a thick paste, then poured into a mold for baking. Timing it to perfection allows the outer layer to solidify while the filling remains soft and gooey, just like a real volcano.

blubbercream.name: Blubbercream
blubbercream.effect:
Increases all party members' DEF by 215–308 and healing effectiveness by 6–10% for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
blubbercream.description: Aqua-blue ice cream. The best way to while away a sweltering day is by enjoying some refreshing ice cream. It chills the body and cools the soul, giving one a feeling akin to having leaped into the sea, all worries dissipating as the heat flees your mouth, leaving naught but pure joy.

bubblemilk-pie.name: Bubblemilk Pie
bubblemilk-pie.effect:
Increases all party members' DEF by 165–235 for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
bubblemilk-pie.description: An innovative stuffed dessert. Crispy puff pastry, creamy filling, and the surprising sensation of bubbles bursting in sequence... This post-meal treat brings satisfaction to every taste bud. Remember to enjoy it while it's warm!

candy-shells.name: Candy Shells
candy-shells.effect:
Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 25–35% and DEF by 165–235 for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
candy-shells.description: Candies in a variety of different shapes. It is said that a tiny fraction of the Candy Shells sold at the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland contain real pearls, and that the pleasure of tasting these is reserved for only the very luckiest of visitors. Might you be one of them?

crisp-croissant-combo.name: Crisp Croissant Combo
crisp-croissant-combo.effect:
Decreases Stamina depleted by climbing and sprinting for all party members by 15–25% for 900s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
crisp-croissant-combo.description: A small pastry-and-coffee combo. Roll and fold the dough, lather it in egg wash, and place the creation into the oven. Soon, it will have expanded into an exquisite pastry, piping hot as it triumphantly exits the oven. It is said that the act of brushing the egg wash on is like a baker's signature — and it seems this one has fine penmanship indeed.

delights-of-wondrous-wanderings.name: Delights of Wondrous Wanderings
delights-of-wondrous-wanderings.effect: Restores 30–34% of Max HP and an additional 600–1,900 HP to the selected character.
delights-of-wondrous-wanderings.description: A dessert box based on the recipes of several different companions, simply overflowing with heartfelt intentions. Neatly arranged rows of delicate pastries line the box — but what will this goodwill gesture taste like?

drunken-plums-in-snow.name: Drunken Plums in Snow
drunken-plums-in-snow.effect:
Increases all party members' DEF by 215–308 and healing effectiveness by 6–10% for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
drunken-plums-in-snow.description: An elegant-looking Liyue dish. Once the crab is steamed, its roe and meat are carefully removed, stir-fried, then returned to the shell. Egg whites are whipped into a frothy coating to seal the crab shell, topped with finely chopped ham for a touch of color, then the whole thing is baked. Together, the succulent crab meat and fluffy egg whites make a combination that's sure to impress.

eight-treasure-duck.name: Eight-Treasure Duck
eight-treasure-duck.effect:
Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 25–35% and DEF by 165–235 for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
eight-treasure-duck.description: A dish that needs true skill to make. Eight kinds of meat and vegetables, known as the eight treasures, are stuffed into a deboned duck. This is then molded into the shape of a gourd, to represent good fortune and auspiciousness. Exquisite ingredients, superb cutting skills, and phenomenal timing are all needed, that the finished dish might be worthy of its place as the final course at any banquet.

fontinalia-mousse.name: Fontinalia Mousse
fontinalia-mousse.effect:
Increases all party members' ATK by 224–320 and CRIT Rate by 6–10% for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
fontinalia-mousse.description: A true blue Fontinalia Festival snack. This mousse is shaped in the image of the Lakelight Lily's bud. After the Festival's customs were changed to align more with dessert delectation, it quickly came to be a much-favored Fontainian food favorite. Don't forget to share them with all the trial-or-treaters who come your way!

golden-apple-pastry.name: Golden Apple Pastry
golden-apple-pastry.effect:
Increases all party members' ATK by 224–320 and CRIT Rate by 6–10% for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
golden-apple-pastry.description: A little dessert made from apples. After being sliced into evenly sized pieces, the apples are mixed with sugar and other spices. The mixture is boiled until it thickens, then wrapped in square puff pastry and baked until it turns golden and puffy. The crispy puff pastry envelops a soft filling within, a delicious treat suitable for anyone.

humbly-enough.name: Humbly Enough
humbly-enough.effect:
Restores 26–30% of Max HP to the selected character.
Regenerates 450–790 HP every 5s for the next 30s.
humbly-enough.description: A spiced tofu dish. Sautéed tofu is stir-fried with the sauce until browned and ready to serve. Despite the ordinary ingredients, the resulting dish is particularly mellow and fragrant, a perfect partner for rice. It can be said to be the home cook's dish of choice.

meat-lover-s-feast.name: Meat-Lover's Feast
meat-lover-s-feast.effect:
Increases all party members' ATK by 224–320 and CRIT Rate by 6–10% for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
meat-lover-s-feast.description: A combo meal of meat and coffee. A crispy fried chicken cutlet wrapped in fresh greens, paired with peeled shrimp tails. This bold marriage of flavors hailing from land and water sparks an epiphany: Culinary delights, like an adventure into uncharted lands, are full of infinite possibilities.

mega-meaty-sushi.name: Mega-Meaty Sushi
mega-meaty-sushi.effect: Restores 30–34% of Max HP and an additional 600–1,900 HP to the selected character.
mega-meaty-sushi.description: Sushi made using barbecued meat. Layer upon layer of meat, thin and tender, is piled up in the same way that earth and stone pack together to form a mountain, with the delicate radish paste forming its snow-capped peak. This dish is not only a feast for the eyes, but for the mouth also.

mint-bubblegum.name: Mint Bubblegum
mint-bubblegum.effect:
Revives the selected character.
Restores 900–1,500 HP.
mint-bubblegum.description: A soft, chewy candy featuring a blend of two distinct flavors. With a bit of practice, you can blow impressively massive bubbles! Just watch out — if you push it too far and the bubble pops, you'll end up with a face full of sticky goo!

nine-fruit-nectar.name: Nine-Fruit Nectar
nine-fruit-nectar.effect:
Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 10–20% for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
nine-fruit-nectar.description: A blended juice cocktail. Mixed with balanced precision, the drink interweaves the flavors of various fruits and preserves their sweet and tangy deliciousness, elevated by a handful of ice cubes.

right-at-home.name: Right at Home
right-at-home.effect:
Increases all party members' DEF by 165–235 for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
right-at-home.description: A staple dish made by frying ham, bird eggs, and other ingredients with rice. The wide choice of constituent ingredients that may be chosen and different ways of cooking make it a welcome dish in almost every house in Liyue.

spiced-fried-chicken.name: Spiced Fried Chicken
spiced-fried-chicken.effect:
Restores 30–35% of Max HP to the selected character.
Regenerates 510–930 HP every 5s for the next 30s.
spiced-fried-chicken.description: Fried chicken wrapped in a crispy green skin. The chicken is wrapped in a paste mixed with spices before being deep-fried. They say that finishing this will induce within you an urge to study hard... Can there be such an amazing thing in this world?

the-palace-jewels.name: The Palace Jewels
the-palace-jewels.effect:
Increases all party members' Max HP by 20–25% for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
the-palace-jewels.description: A deliciously fragrant Liyue dish. Shrimp meat is battered and cooked with rich crab roe. The roe is as radiant gold, while the shrimp sparkles like jade, hence the name "The Palace Jewels."

thick-cut-duelist-s-burger.name: Thick-Cut Duelist's Burger
thick-cut-duelist-s-burger.effect:
Increases all party members' ATK by 224–320 and CRIT Rate by 6–10% for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
thick-cut-duelist-s-burger.description: A burger with a thick-cut steak as its main ingredient. The sumptuous bread gives off a pleasantly toasty aroma, which complements the rich sauce lavished on the thick steak. A variety of garnishes serve to enrich the mouthfeel and provide added nutritional value.

trembling-strings-and-rushing-reeds.name: Trembling Strings and Rushing Reeds
trembling-strings-and-rushing-reeds.effect:
Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 10–20% for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
trembling-strings-and-rushing-reeds.description: A unique meat dish. A variety of shredded meat is kneaded and fried for flavor. The complex ingredients and different textures make this dish quite the test of a chef's skills and is a rarity even in some of the most well-known restaurants.

hearthfires-trail.name: Hearthfire's Trail
hearthfires-trail.effect: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 570 HP every 5s for 30s.
hearthfires-trail.description: Arlecchino's specialty. The vivid red sauce traces a warm path across the dish, carrying a flavor as direct and unforgettable as its maker.

fashion-show.name: Fashion Show
fashion-show.effect: Restores 34% of Max HP to the selected character. Regenerates 980 HP every 5s for the next 30s.
fashion-show.description: Chiori's specialty. A familiar fish-shaped snack has been dressed with careful detail, turning a simple sweet into something crisp, elegant, and unmistakably stylish.

boredom-busting-bubblegum.name: Boredom-Busting Bubblegum
boredom-busting-bubblegum.effect: Revives the selected character. Restores 15% of Max HP, then restores an additional 550 HP.
boredom-busting-bubblegum.description: Lohen's specialty. A playful twist on mint bubblegum, made to snap attention back into the room with a bright, chewy burst of sweetness.
